description: This file implements HTTP handlers for OpenAI-compatible chat completion API endpoints, including request parsing, image handling, streaming responses, and event management within a server environment.

methods.name: resolveOpenAiChatCompletionsLimits
methods.description: Resolves and returns limits for OpenAI chat completions based on provided configuration.

methods.name: writeSse
methods.description: Writes Server-Sent Events data to the response.

methods.name: buildAgentCommandInput
methods.description: Constructs command input object for agent execution based on prompt parameters.

methods.name: writeAssistantRoleChunk
methods.description: Sends a chunk indicating the assistant's role in the SSE stream.

methods.name: writeAssistantContentChunk
methods.description: Sends a chunk of assistant's generated content in the SSE stream.

methods.name: asMessages
methods.description: Converts unknown input to an array of message objects.

methods.name: extractTextContent
methods.description: Extracts text content from various message content formats.

methods.name: resolveImageUrlPart
methods.description: Resolves an image URL part, handling data URIs and raw URLs.

methods.name: extractImageUrls
methods.description: Extracts image URLs from message content.

methods.name: parseImageUrlToSource
methods.description: Parses an image URL into a source object, handling data URIs and URL strings.

methods.name: resolveActiveTurnContext
methods.description: Determines the current active turn context from message history.

methods.name: resolveImagesForRequest
methods.description: Resolves image content for a request, respecting size and count limits.

methods.name: buildAgentPrompt
methods.description: Builds a prompt message and optional system prompt from message history.

methods.name: coerceRequest
methods.description: Coerces an unknown value into an OpenAI chat completion request object.

methods.name: resolveAgentResponseText
methods.description: Extracts and concatenates response text from agent payloads.

methods.name: handleOpenAiHttpRequest
methods.description: Main handler for OpenAI chat completion HTTP requests, supporting streaming and non-streaming modes.
